---
name: Bug report
about: Something in Kartaa does not work as expected
title: ""
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Summary
One or two sentences: what is wrong, in the user's words.

## Reported by and when
Who found it, the date, and where (demo, staging, production). Release (R1 to R4).

## Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in as ... (demo: `demo@example.com` after `./demo.sh`)
2. Go to ...
3. Do ...

## Expected
What should happen.

## Actual
What happens instead. Quote the exact on-screen message.

## Root cause
The code path, with file and line, once known. Say "not known yet" until then.

## Fix
The change made or proposed, and any decision it needs (DECISIONS.md id). Link the PR.

## Tests
Tests added or changed, and what was run.

## Retest steps
How the reporter can confirm the fix after merge.

## Severity
low / medium / high, and who is affected (tenant data, tax figures, filing, or display only).
